problem: The 27-petal Queen menu had no complete keyboard map, and a local event monitor could capture stale SwiftUI navigation state and keep intercepting digit shortcuts after a screen opened.
solution: Added one tested menu shortcut policy for Command, Option, and Control digit rows, moved navigation into a reference-backed observable state, restricted routing to the visible main menu, updated hosted-route metadata, and generated matching tooltip labels.
lesson: Escaping local event monitors must read navigation from reference-backed state. Capturing SwiftUI value state can preserve the initial menu visibility and create shortcut conflicts inside destination screens.
